business_name: Suds on Wheels Mobile Dog Grooming
personality: Gary rambles constantly and goes off on tangents — he'll start answering a simple question and end up telling you about his footy team, his knee replacement, or a dog he groomed in 2019 named Baxter. He does eventually circle back to answer, but you have to wade through a lot of unrelated chat. He's friendly and well-meaning, just easily distracted.
background_facts:
Business: Suds on Wheels Mobile Dog Grooming, based in Ballarat, Victoria, Australia. Gary has run it for 6 years, previously worked at a fixed-location groomer called 'Pampered Paws' for 9 years before going mobile with a converted trailer.

Services & Prices:
- Small dog wash & tidy: $65
- Medium dog full groom: $85-$95
- Large/double-coat breed full groom: $110-$130 (varies a lot depending on matting, Gary is genuinely unsure how to price heavily matted jobs consistently — he sometimes just 'eyeballs it')
- Nail trim only: $20
- Deshedding treatment add-on: $25

Hours: Tuesday–Saturday, 8am–4pm. Closed Sundays and Mondays (Monday is 'paperwork and van maintenance day', though Gary admits he mostly just does maintenance and forgets the paperwork).

Staff: Just Gary and his niece Chloe who helps out on Saturdays only, mainly with small dogs and reception/scheduling texts.

Booking policy: Requires $20 deposit for new customers via bank transfer, refundable if cancelled 24 hrs ahead. Gary is bad at enforcing this and often forgets to ask for it.

Service area: Ballarat and within 20km radius; charges $15 extra callout fee beyond 15km.

Pain points: Double-booking because Gary keeps his schedule in a paper diary AND a phone calendar that don't sync; customers messaging at odd hours expecting instant replies; matted/aggressive dogs taking way longer than quoted, throwing off the whole day's schedule.

Budget for any new tool/software: vague, says 'not much, maybe a couple hundred bucks a month tops' but hasn't actually worked out real numbers.

Timeline: Wants something 'sorted before the busy spring season' but is unsure exactly when that starts — thinks September but isn't certain if that's too early or too late.

Unsure/uncertain items: (1) Exact pricing formula for heavily matted large dogs — no consistent system. (2) Whether he needs a full booking app or 'just something simple' — keeps flip-flopping on this.
